documents.title: Acme documentation index
documents.text: Acme documentation includes an index entry for retention and deletion. This overview does not specify any policy duration. The product supports onboarding, workspaces, contact lookup, researcher assignments, search, exports, labels, folders, notifications, reports, dashboards, account preferences, accessibility settings, localization, documentation, operational metrics, maintenance windows, feature announcements, release notes, migration notes, troubleshooting, frequently asked questions, customer success guides, and administration references. Each feature has a separate source document. This directory is navigation material, and any substantive answer must consult the relevant policy source.

documents.title: Acme retention policy
documents.text: Acme retention policy: deletion of research exports occurs after 30 days. Audit receipts remain for 90 days. These are synthetic policy values.

documents.title: Beacon support response
documents.text: Beacon support response: the priority support response target is 2 hours during business hours. Routine requests have a 2 business day target.

documents.title: Cedar incident escalation
documents.text: Cedar incident escalation: unresolved incidents escalate to the duty manager after 24 hours. The synthetic escalation mailbox is duty@example.invalid.

documents.title: Delta export format
documents.text: Delta export format: research evidence exports use NDJSON. Every row contains source_id, version, start, end, and quoted text. Attachments are excluded.
